item.title: Ukraine calendar: What will happen this week
item.description: Editor's note: This article is a shortened on-site version of KI Insights' public newsletter, The Week Ahead, covering events from February 16-22. Sign up here to start your week with an agenda of Ukraine-related events delivered directly to your inbox every week. Audio version of The Week

item.title: EU says no shortcut to Ukraine reforms amid 2027 membership speculation
item.description: "Let's have this discussion, with one baseline: full membership comes only after full reforms," Marta Kos, the European Commissioner for Enlargement, said on Feb. 13 in Tallinn.

item.title: Using Starlink ruse, Ukrainian cyber forces trick Russian soldiers into revealing positions, donating to armed forces
item.description: The group received $5,870 from Russian soldiers seeking to restore connectivity which it is donating to fundraising efforts for Ukrainian drones.

item.title: Ukraine War Latest: UK to spend $545M on hypersonic weapons after Ukraine battlefield lessons
item.description: Key developments on Feb. 13Ukraine's battlefield lessons drive UK to spend over $545 million on hypersonic, long-range weapons in 2026Using Starlink ruse, Ukrainian cyber forces trick Russian soldiers into revealing positions, donating to armed forces'Modern Ukrainian technology, battle-tested' — Zelensky unveils 1st drone

item.title: Zelensky has to 'get moving' on peace deal, Trump says
item.description: "Russia wants to make a deal and Zelensky is going to have to get moving, otherwise he's going to miss a great opportunity," Trump claimed when speaking to reporters on Feb. 13. "He has to move."

item.title: Rubio skips Ukraine meeting with European leaders at Munich conference
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio skipped a Berlin Format Ukraine meeting at the Munich Security Conference, raising concerns among European officials amid broader transatlantic tensions, the Financial Times reported Feb. 13.

item.title: Zelensky meets with Iranian opposition figure Reza Pahlavi
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky met with Reza Pahlavi, Iranian opposition figure and exiled son of the country's last monarch, on the sidelines of the Munich Security Conference on Feb. 13.

item.title: 'It means more than any medal' — Ukraine's skeleton racer sacrifices Olympic dream to honor war victims

item.title: 'Terrorizing the civilian population' — At least 2 injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv Oblast
item.description: The attack targeted the Vyshhorod district of Ukraine's national capital region, which is located on the northern outskirts of Kyiv. Regional Governor Mykola Kalashnyk reported that a man and a woman were hospitalized with injuries stemming from the attack.

item.title: Over 177,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine identified by media investigation
item.description: Russian independent media outlet Mediazona, in collaboration with the BBC Russian service, has confirmed the identities of 177,433 Russian military personnel killed in Ukraine.
